what: The retrieval a correct system must produce for the fixture corpus, best first. `citations` is the ordered list the top-k result must BEGIN with: rank is asserted, so a reversed or shuffled ranking fails. `document`/`page` restate rank 1 for readability.
note: Fictional corpus, no real personal data. The list stops where the ground truth stops: the corpus has disjoint vocabulary, so which chunk answers a question is determined, while a further citation from an unrelated document may be a hash artefact of the lexical stub and is not asserted. Ranking past rank 1 IS asserted (the prefix), which is what makes the page evaluation able to fail at all: before this, every question recorded exactly one citation, so a reversed ranking was unrepresentable.
